items.description: Median tonnage and median grade of deposit types (USGS descriptive and grade-tonnage models)
items.unit: tonnage Mt; grade unit in the row label
items.note: Medians transcribed from Cox & Singer (1986) model summaries without the bulletin to hand; treat each as correct to within a factor of ~2 in tonnage and ~30% in grade, and verify against the bulletin before any test gates on them more tightly. Deposit sizes are lognormal with log10 standard deviations of roughly 0.6-0.9 in tonnage.

items.note: Only about 1% of known kimberlites are economic; most carry trace or no diamonds.
